history.notes: First release. Display-only AV source (branded-av-source template): satellite proxy named "Xbox" + one HDMI OUT binding (HDMI + STEREO), so selecting the console in Watch switches the room's video input and audio path. · Branded Xbox tile across the full Navigator AV icon ladder (driver-local generator; distinct from the PlayStation sibling at every size). · Deliberately NO power control: consoles have no reliable one-cable power protocol — wake from the controller / HDMI-CEC. Network wake-on-select is a roadmap item, append-only if it can be made reliable.
